name: 50533 · Eagle Grove, IA
findings: ZIP 50533 (Eagle Grove) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50533 (Eagle Grove) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 50533 (Eagle Grove) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
